name: Ridgecrest Earthquakes
summary: A magnitude 6.4 on July 4 turned out to be the foreshock of a magnitude 7.1 34 hours later, the largest California earthquake in 20 years. Shaking was felt across Los Angeles.
glendale_link: Shows how a sequence can escalate, and how far strong shaking travels.

quakes.place: 18 km SSW of Searles Valley, CA
19 km ESE of Little Lake, CA
